sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 回想当年我在黑胶唱片时代在夜总会打碟时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班，然后把DJ台变成一个美丽的、有50年历史的古董的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In Brazil, many believe that once former President Jair Bolsonaro had left office, the threat of violence from his supporters would recede.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，许多人曾认为，一旦前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗离任，来自其支持者的暴力威胁就会消退。

sentences.en: They were wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们错了。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Jack Nickus on the storming of Brazil's capital.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事杰克·尼库斯将讲述巴西首都遭冲击事件。

sentences.en: Wednesday, January 11th.
sentences.zh: 1月11日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jack, what was your reaction when you realized that this attack was underway in Brasilia?
sentences.zh: 杰克，当你意识到这场袭击正在巴西利亚发生时，你的第一反应是什么？

sentences.en: I think there was a sense of here we go because I had been, as sad as it sounds, been waiting for this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有一种“又来了”的感觉，因为说来难过，我一直在等待这一刻的发生，已经等了很久。

sentences.en: I have been reporting on the anger and the delusion of the right-wing movement here in Brazil for nearly a year and a half.
sentences.zh: 将近一年半以来，我一直在报道这里右翼运动的愤怒和妄想。

sentences.en: And we had been fearful that something like this was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我们一直很担心会发生这样的事情。

sentences.en: And then suddenly, you know, as I watched this live stream on my computer from my home in Rio, it was unfolding real quickly.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间，你知道的，当我坐在里约热内卢的家中通过电脑观看直播时，事态发展得极快。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's kind of like knowing that something you feared would happen and being right in the worst possible way.
sentences.zh: 这有点像明知会发生你所恐惧的事，而结果却以最糟糕的方式应验了。

sentences.en: I mean, you had come on the show a couple months ago and explained this fear of yours that violence was in the air around the last Brazilian presidential election.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，几个月前你曾上过节目，解释过你对上届巴西总统大选期间暴力阴云密布的担忧。

sentences.en: So just remind us why you were so worried that something like this was about to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以请提醒我们，你为什么如此担心会发生这样的事。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So the election pitted Jair Bolsonaro, the far-right incumbent president, a very much a Trump-like figure against Luis Anasio Lula da Silva,
sentences.zh: 当时的大选在极右翼现任总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗——一个非常类似特朗普的人物——与路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦之间展开，
zh_words: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席

sentences.en: a leftist former president challenging Bolsonaro to return for a third term.
sentences.zh: 后者是一位左翼前总统，向博索纳罗发起挑战以期赢得第三个任期。

sentences.en: And it was an extremely divisive election.
sentences.zh: 这是一场极具分裂性的选举。

sentences.en: People from Lula's side calling Bolsonaro genocidal.
sentences.zh: 卢拉阵营的人称博索纳罗为杀人犯。

sentences.en: People from Bolsonaro's side calling Lula a criminal who must be stopped.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗阵营的人则称卢拉是个必须被阻止的罪犯。

sentences.en: But most importantly, you know, for me, what really worried me was Bolsonaro for more than a year had basically been suggesting that he might not accept the results.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，对我而言，真正让我担心的是，博索纳罗一年多来基本一直在暗示他可能不会接受选举结果。

sentences.en: And he had, for actually years, been systematically undermining the electorate's confidence in the election systeMs.
sentences.zh: 而且多年来，他一直在系统性地破坏选民对选举制度的信心。

sentences.en: So Brazil is actually the only country in the world to use a fully digital voting system with no paper backups.
sentences.zh: 所以巴西其实是世界上唯一一个使用全数字投票系统且没有纸质备份的国家。

sentences.en: And Bolsonaro has seized on that as, essentially, to him, enough evidence that it can't be trusted.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗抓住了这一点，对他而言，这基本上构成了不值得信任的充足证据。

sentences.en: That it's a black box and that everything can be hacked.
sentences.zh: 认为这是一个黑箱，一切都可以被黑客攻击。

sentences.en: There's no paper backups.
sentences.zh: 没有纸质备份。

sentences.en: And he has used a number of misleading statements, conspiracy theories, and, in some cases,
sentences.zh: 他使用了大量具有误导性的言论、阴谋论，在某些情况下，

sentences.en: just downright falsehoods to spread what is essentially the lie that the election system is rife with fraud.
sentences.zh: 甚至是彻头彻尾的谎言，来散布选举制度充斥着舞弊这一本质上的谎言。

sentences.en: He actually has had a quote that he has said is, you say that I can't prove there was fraud, but you can't prove there wasn't.
sentences.zh: 他实际上说过这样一句名言：你们说我无法证明存在舞弊，但你们也无法证明没有舞弊。

sentences.en: He was always seeding a little bit of doubt and leaving himself a window to potentially try to exploit in the case that he loSt.
sentences.zh: 他一直在埋下怀疑的种子，给自己留出一个窗口，以便在落败的情况下伺机利用。

sentences.en: So all of that, of course, is concerning when it's coming from the president of the nation.
sentences.zh: 因此，当这些言论出自国家总统之口时，所有这一切当然都令人担忧。

sentences.en: But to me, what was far more concerning was the fact that it worked.
sentences.zh: 但在我看来，更令人担忧的事实是，这起作用了。

sentences.en: We could see clearly in national polls that three out of four of his supporters had little to no faith in the election systeMs.
sentences.zh: 我们在全国民调中可以清楚地看到，四分之三的支持者对选举制度几乎没有或根本没有信心。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so as the election approached and polls continued to show Bolsonaro behind, I was really worried about what the reaction would be from his supporters if he ultimately loSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着大选临近，民调继续显示博索纳罗落后，如果他最终落败，我真的很担心他的支持者会做出什么反应。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then, of course, right after we spoke with you last time, Jack, Bolsonaro does lose.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然就在我们上次与你交谈后不久，杰克，博索纳罗确实落败了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And when that happens, we're sort of bracing for what comes next.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时，我们都在某种程度上为接下来要发生的事做好了心理准备。

sentences.en: And at first, he remained completely silent.
sentences.zh: 起初，他保持了完全的沉默。

sentences.en: And in that sort of vacuum, his supporters began going to the streets.
sentences.zh: 在这种真空状态下，他的支持者开始走上街头。

sentences.en: And so after two really tense days, Bolsonaro finally announces he has a speech.
sentences.zh: 经过两天紧张的对峙，博索纳罗终于宣布他将发表讲话。

sentences.en: The nation is watching.
sentences.zh: 全国都在关注。

sentences.en: It's this big, enormous national live TV moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大且轰动的全国电视直播时刻。

sentences.en: And he walks to the podium and gives this short and rather mealy-mouthed speech.
sentences.zh: 他走到讲台前，发表了一篇简短且相当含糊其辞的讲话。

sentences.en: In which he touts his record and then says that he supported peaceful protests.
sentences.zh: 他在讲话中吹嘘了自己的政绩，然后表示他支持和平抗议。

sentences.en: But notes that they are inspired by, quote, feelings of injustice in the electoral process.
sentences.zh: 但同时也指出，这些抗议是由引用原话“选举过程中的不公正感”所激发的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And then he walks off and everybody's sort of like, is he conceding or not?
sentences.zh: 然后他走下台，所有人都觉得，他这到底是在认输还是没认输？

sentences.en: And then his chief of staff comes to the lectern.
sentences.zh: 接着他的办公厅主任走上讲台。

sentences.en: And says, the president has authorized me to transition power.
sentences.zh: 并表示，总统已授权我进行权力交接。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So in some sense, we breathe a sigh of relief because it means there's not going to be an attempt to hold on to power.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种意义上，我们松了一口气，因为这意味着不会有人试图死赖着权力不放。

sentences.en: But his sort of half concession did very little to tamp down the protests.
sentences.zh: 但他这种半吞半吐的认输并没有起到什么作用来平息抗议。

sentences.en: And in fact, the next day, they only grew.
sentences.zh: 事实上，第二天抗议活动反而愈演愈烈。

sentences.en: Bolsonaro supporters have taken advantage of a national holiday here in Brazil to hold protests outside army barracks in nine states across Brazil.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗的支持者利用巴西的一个全国法定假日，在巴西九个州的军队营房外举行了抗议活动。

sentences.en: It seems they heeded the call by the president to hold peaceful protests.
sentences.zh: 看来他们听从了总统举行和平抗议的号召。

sentences.en: The protests move to these enormous demonstrations outside military bases around the nation.
sentences.zh: 抗议活动转移到了全国各地军事基地外的大型示威活动。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And I want the military to take power.
sentences.zh: 我希望军方接管政权。

sentences.en: It's not ideal, but it's a million times better than Lula's Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 这并不完美，但比卢拉的共产党要好上一百万倍。

sentences.en: Basically, these people are demanding the military intervene in the government, take control and keep Bolsonaro in power or at least block Lula from taking power.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这些人要求军方介入政府，接管控制权，让博索纳罗继续掌权，或者至少阻止卢拉上台。

sentences.en: Put simply, they want a military coup.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他们想要一场军事政变。

sentences.en: An astonishing sight in a country that 40 years ago brought an end to a repressive military dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 这在一个40年前才刚刚结束残酷军事独裁统治的国家里，是一个令人震惊的景象。

sentences.en: And this was a really concerning moment for the country because you have to remember that Brazil suffered through a military dictatorship from 1964 just to 1985, not that long ago.
sentences.zh: 对这个国家来说，这是一个真正令人担忧的时刻，因为你必须记住，巴西从1964年到1985年饱受军事独裁之苦，那其实并没有过去多久。

sentences.en: And you now had thousands of people calling for the military to intervene and take control.
sentences.zh: 而现在你却看到成千上万的人呼吁军方介入并接管控制权。

sentences.en: And for a lot of Brazilians, that was scary.
sentences.zh: 对于许多巴西人来说，这很可怕。

sentences.en: But at the same time, nothing really came of it.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，事情并没有真正发生。

sentences.en: Everyone in government was accepting Lula's victory.
sentences.zh: 政府中的每个人都在接受卢拉的胜利。

sentences.en: The government was transitioning.
sentences.zh: 政府正在进行权力交接。

sentences.en: And actually, these Bolsonaro supporters outside the military bases, they almost became a sort of meme on the left in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这些军事基地外的博索纳罗支持者，在巴西左翼看来几乎成了一种模因（梗）。

sentences.en: There was memes of them stuck in the rain.
sentences.zh: 有他们在雨中被困的表情包。

sentences.en: There was viral videos about them trying to use their cell phones to summon aliens to come help.
sentences.zh: 还有关于他们试图用手机召唤外星人来帮忙的病毒式传播视频。

sentences.en: And they almost became a little bit of a laughing stock on the left in Brazil, framed as losers who didn't get their way.
sentences.zh: 他们在巴西左翼眼中几乎成了笑柄，被塑造成没有达到目的的失败者。

sentences.en: And I think that was in part because the military was making no signs that it was going to comply with these demands.
sentences.zh: 我想部分原因是因为军方没有任何迹象表明它会顺应这些诉求。

sentences.en: In the meantime, Bolsonaro wasn't really making any public statements.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，博索纳罗并没有发表任何公开声明。

sentences.en: And we get to the end of the year, and these are the final days of his presidency.
sentences.zh: 转眼到了年底，这是他总统任期的最后几天。

sentences.en: And suddenly, he announces he's got an address to the nation.
sentences.zh: 突然，他宣布将向全国发表讲话。

sentences.en: And this turns out it's kind of his farewell address as president.
sentences.zh: 结果证明，这可以说是他作为总统的告别演讲。

sentences.en: He says that he had tried within the laws of Brazil to overturn the election, but he failed.
sentences.zh: 他说他曾在巴西法律范围内试图推翻选举，但他失败了。

sentences.en: And he essentially suggested that his supporters should give up.
sentences.zh: 他基本上暗示他的支持者应该放弃。

sentences.en: He said, we either live in a democracy or we don't.
sentences.zh: 他说，要么我们生活在民主之中，要么不生活在其中。

sentences.en: And no one wants an adventure.
sentences.zh: 没有人想要冒险。

sentences.en: And then he boarded a government plane for Florida.
sentences.zh: 然后他登上了飞往佛罗里达的政府专机。

sentences.en: It seems like he's going to stay there for the next few months.
sentences.zh: 看来他要在那里待上几个月了。

sentences.en: So, on December 31st, I fly to Brasilia in order to attend Lula's inauguration on New Year's Day.
sentences.zh: 因此，在12月31日，我飞往巴西利亚，以便参加元旦当天卢拉的就职典礼。

sentences.en: And on New Year's Eve, I know this is really the final day before Lula's set to take office.
sentences.zh: 在除夕夜，我知道这真的是卢拉即将上台前的最后一天。

sentences.en: This is something that the protesters are, you know, bent on preventing.
sentences.zh: 抗议者们，你知道的，正铁了心要阻止这件事发生。

sentences.en: And so I kind of want to go visit them and understand what they're thinking in this moment on, you know, the eve of this thing that they have been so worried about.
sentences.zh: 所以我挺想去看看他们，了解一下在这个他们一直非常担忧的事情发生的前夕，他们心里都在想些什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so I head to the Army headquarters, which has really been the epicenter of these protests.
sentences.zh: 于是我前往陆军总部，这里一直是这些抗议活动的震中。

sentences.en: It's a sort of tent city.
sentences.zh: 这是一个类似帐篷城的地方。

sentences.en: There's a lot of camping tents that people are sleeping in, but then there's these larger structured tents.
sentences.zh: 有许多供人睡觉的露营帐篷，但也有这些大型的结构化帐篷。

sentences.en: And I was really struck by the scale of it, because I had been at this very encampment in the days after the election, you know, sort of on the days when it was just being set up.
sentences.zh: 它的规模让我感到震撼，因为在大选结束后的几天里，我曾去过这个营地，你知道的，就在它刚刚搭建起来的那几天。

sentences.en: And I had expected in some ways that over the past two months, as really the rest of Brazil had moved on, that maybe this would be a smaller version of it.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上我曾预计，在过去的两个月里，随着巴西其余地区继续前进，这或许会成为一个缩小版的营地。

sentences.en: But in fact, it had grown only bigger.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，它不仅没有缩小，反而变得更大了。

sentences.en: There was a shower station, a place to charge your phones.
sentences.zh: 这里有淋浴间，有给手机充电的地方。

sentences.en: There was even a hospital.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一家医院。

sentences.en: There was a church.
sentences.zh: 有一个教堂。

sentences.en: And 28 different food stalls scattered around in order to eat.
sentences.zh: 周围散落着28个不同的食品摊位供人用餐。

sentences.en: And it was organized, and people really kind of had a mission.
sentences.zh: 这里很有组织性，人们确实有一种使命感。

sentences.en: Some people were serving food.
sentences.zh: 有些人负责分发食物。

sentences.en: Others were sort of intelligence, looking out for infiltrators from the left.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则负责情报工作，留意来自左翼的渗透者。

sentences.en: Everyone I spoke to was finding a purpose in this movement.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的每个人都在这场运动中找到了目标。

sentences.en: So as I'm talking to different supporters...
sentences.zh: 正当我与不同的支持者交谈时……

sentences.en: I then come upon this kind of older guy speaking over a PA system.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一个通过扩音系统发言的老年男子。

sentences.en: And in his speech, he was talking about the inauguration in the following day,
sentences.zh: 在演讲中，他谈到了第二天的就职典礼，

sentences.en: and he was saying things like how their movement had this force that was armed and ready to defend Brazil's democracy.
sentences.zh: 他说他们的运动拥有一支武装齐备、随时准备捍卫巴西民主的力量之类的话。

sentences.en: And so, after he finished his speaking, I go up and introduce myself.
sentences.zh: 因此，在他讲完话后，我走过去做了自我介绍。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Magno 040.
sentences.zh: 玛格诺040。

sentences.en: Magno Rodriguez and Magno 040.
sentences.zh: 玛格诺·罗德里格斯，还有玛格诺040。

sentences.en: 040 is my codinome here.
sentences.zh: 040是我的代号。

sentences.en: His name is Magno Rodriguez.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫玛格诺·罗德里格斯。

sentences.en: He's 60 years old.
sentences.zh: 他今年60岁。

sentences.en: Agora você é aposentado?
sentences.zh: 你现在退休了吗？

sentences.en: Sim, sim, não.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，没有。

sentences.en: Estou de licença médica.
sentences.zh: 我在病假中。

sentences.en: He tells me he's on disability.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他在领残疾抚恤金。

sentences.en: He's walking with a cane.
sentences.zh: 他拄着拐杖走路。

sentences.en: You know, at some point, pulls up his shirt and shows me this really gnarly scar down his spine.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在某个时刻，他掀起衬衫，给我看他脊椎上那道非常狰狞的伤疤。

sentences.en: He said that he had done multiple jobs over his career.
sentences.zh: 他说他在职业生涯中做过好几份工作。

sentences.en: You know, he was a janitor, he was a mechanic, he was a driver.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他当过门卫，当过机械师，当过司机。

sentences.en: He told me, at some point, he was an investigative journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，在某个时期，他还是一名调查记者。

sentences.en: And he had become a sort of leader in the camp in some ways.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他已经成了营地里的领袖人物之一。

sentences.en: And just about everyone seemed to know him, constantly coming up and asking him for directions or where something was.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个人似乎都认识他，不断走过来向他打听路线或某个地方在哪里。

sentences.en: And then we start to get into why he was there.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始谈论他为什么会出现在这里。

sentences.en: He is really worried that Lula is going to turn Brazil into a communist nation.
sentences.zh: 他非常担心卢拉会把巴西变成一个共产主义国家。

sentences.en: And pretty quickly, he starts to repeat one of the major conspiracy theories that Bolsonaro had peddled for so long.
sentences.zh: 很快，他就开始重复博索纳罗长期兜售的重大阴谋论之一。

sentences.en: Which is that the voting machines are run by these mysterious algorithms that actually control the results of the election.
sentences.zh: 那就是投票机是由这些神秘的算法运行的，这些算法实际上控制着选举结果。

sentences.en: And he goes on to say that he believes that, you know,
sentences.zh: 接着他说他相信，你知道的，

sentences.en: these sort of political elites and the courts are really controlling the strings of power to ensure that Lula got into office, that they had really rigged the vote.
sentences.zh: 这些政治精英和法院真正掌控着权力之弦，以确保卢拉上台，他们确实操纵了选举。

sentences.en: And as I'm talking to him, I can tell he is deeply convinced of this.
sentences.zh: 当我和他交谈时，我能看出他对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: He's really earnest about it.
sentences.zh: 他是真的很当回事。

sentences.en: And he's really committed to do something to stop Lula.
sentences.zh: 并且他决心做点什么来阻止卢拉。

sentences.en: And, of course, you know, we're now just hours away from the inauguration.
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道的，距离就职典礼现在只有几个小时了。

sentences.en: And so I ask him, I mean, what's going to happen?
sentences.zh: 所以我问他，我的意思是，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: There's no signs that anything is going to stop Lula.
sentences.zh: 没有任何迹象表明有什么能阻止卢拉。

sentences.en: And he tells me that he's convinced that at the last minute, as Lula is about to take office, the military will swoop in and stop him.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他坚信在最后一刻，就在卢拉即将上台时，军方会从天而降并阻止他。

sentences.en: And I was kind of stunned with his commitment and how entrenched he was.
sentences.zh: 他的坚定以及他的根深蒂固让我感到有些震惊。

sentences.en: And I asked him, I said, if Lula is inaugurated tomorrow, I mean, what's your plans?
sentences.zh: 我问他，我说，如果卢拉明天宣誓就职，我的意思是，你有什么打算？

sentences.en: How long are you willing to stay here?
sentences.zh: 你愿意在这里呆多久？

sentences.en: And he told me, basically, for the rest of his life.
sentences.zh: 他基本上告诉我说，余生都在这里度过。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And Jack, just to orient us, how far are the people in this tent city from the seat of power in Brasilia?
sentences.zh: 杰克，为了让我们有个概念，这个帐篷城的人距离巴西利亚的权力中心有多远？

sentences.en: They're just a few miles down the road before you hit the Supreme Court, Congress, and the presidential offices.
sentences.zh: 距离最高法院、国会和总统府只有几英里远。

sentences.en: And so the next day, I go to the inauguration.
sentences.zh: 第二天，我去参加了就职典礼。

sentences.en: I watch Lula take the presidential sash and give a big speech, talks about unifying the country.
sentences.zh: 我看着卢拉接过总统绶带并发表了一场长篇大论，谈到了国家的统一。

sentences.en: And he's president.
sentences.zh: 然后他成了总统。

sentences.en: And so that means that for many of these protesters like Magno,
sentences.zh: 这意味着对于像马格诺这样的许多抗议者来说，

sentences.en: this vision that they had of the military swooping in or Bolsonaro flying back to triumphantly retake power did not happen and wasn't going to happen.
sentences.zh: 他们所设想的军队神兵天降或者博索纳罗飞回来凯旋夺权并没有发生，也不会发生。

sentences.en: And so it dawned on these protesters that if anyone was going to do something about this, it was going to be them.
sentences.zh: 因此这些抗议者渐渐意识到，如果有人要为此做点什么，那只能靠他们自己。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯DealBook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的舞台上现场采访商业、政治和文化领域的一些核心领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在NYTimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家锁定收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: So, Jack, what do we know so far about this moment where protesters storm the Capitol?
sentences.zh: 那么，杰克，对于抗议者冲击国会大厦这一刻，我们目前了解多少？

sentences.en: So, we're still figuring a lot out, but what we know is that in the days leading up to the protests,
sentences.zh: 我们仍在摸索很多情况，但我们所知道的是，在抗议活动前的几天里，

sentences.en: there were calls put out on social media for a mass demonstration in the center of Brazil's capital of Brasilia.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上发出了在巴西首都巴西利亚中心进行大规模游行的号召。

sentences.en: And so, on Sunday, people from around Brasilia, including from the camp that I had visited, and many other camps around the nation arrived in Brasilia.
sentences.zh: 因此，在周日，来自巴西利亚各地的人们，包括我访问过的营地以及全国各地的许多营地的人，都抵达了巴西利亚。

sentences.en: Some of them on foot, some by car, and we also know that there were at least 100 buses carrying at least 4,000 people into the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 他们有的步行，有的乘车，我们还知道至少有100辆载着至少4000人的大巴开进了国会山。

sentences.en: And by early afternoon of Sunday, we had thousands of people amassing on what is essentially the National Mall of Brazil,
sentences.zh: 到了周日下午早些时候，我们发现数千人聚集在堪称巴西国家广场的地方，

sentences.en: which leads directly to the three most important government buildings, the Supreme Court, Congress, and the presidential offices.
sentences.zh: 这里直通三个最重要的政府建筑：最高法院、国会和总统府。

sentences.en: And these are actually symbols of Brazilian power and of Brasilia.
sentences.zh: 这些实际上是巴西权力和巴西利亚的象征。

sentences.en: These are these modernist architectural gems that were opened in 1960 and that are really unusual government buildings.
sentences.zh: 这些现代主义建筑瑰宝于1960年落成，是非常罕见的政府建筑。

sentences.en: And this was a Sunday.
sentences.zh: 而且那天是星期天。

sentences.en: So, the good thing was these buildings were largely vacant, and yet security forces were supposed to be in place, according to authorities.
sentences.zh: 所以，好消息是这些大楼基本上是空无一人的，但据当局称，安全部队本应在岗。

sentences.en: But nevertheless, we saw very quickly these large crowds, you know, draped in the yellow of the national soccer team, streaming up a ramp onto the roof of Congress.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们很快看到大批身穿国家足球队黄色球衣的民众涌上坡道，冲上了国会屋顶。

sentences.en: And then just moments later, another group was down below, pushing their way inside of Congress.
sentences.zh: 紧接着，另一群人在下面挤进了国会内部。

sentences.en: And they seemed to gain pretty easy entry, breaking their way in.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎相当轻易地就闯了进去，破门而入。

sentences.en: At the same time, there was a separate group splintered off that went to the left, that broke into the presidential offices,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，有一小拨人分流去了左边，闯入了总统府，

sentences.en: and then another group that went to the right and broke into the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 另一拨人去了右边，闯入了最高法院。

sentences.en: One of the videos I watched was this protester as he pushed his way into Congress saying,
sentences.zh: 我看到的其中一段视频里，一个抗议者在挤进国会时说：

sentences.en: This is our Congress.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的国会。

sentences.en: We're in power now.
sentences.zh: 现在我们掌权了。

sentences.en: And it was a moment where you realize that these protesters, who had been pushed aside and not really thought about,
sentences.zh: 那一刻你会意识到，这些一直被边缘化、不被重视的抗议者，

sentences.en: suddenly were in control of the three most important buildings in the Brazilian government.
sentences.zh: 突然之间掌控了巴西政府最重要的三座建筑。

sentences.en: And they were destroying them.
sentences.zh: 而且他们正在摧毁这些建筑。

sentences.en: Stunning.
sentences.zh: 太震撼了。

sentences.en: They destroyed computers, they broke glass, threw furniture out of windows, stole documents, ripped priceless art out of their frames.
sentences.zh: 他们砸毁电脑，打破玻璃，把家具扔出窗外，盗走文件，把无价的艺术品从画框中撕下来。

sentences.en: And in some reports in the presidential offices, they urinated in some rooMs.
sentences.zh: 根据一些报道，在总统府里，他们还在一些房间里随地小便。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So eventually, the armed forces arrived.
sentences.zh: 最终，武装部队抵达了。

sentences.en: The same soldiers that these protesters were calling on to come take control of the government were now arriving to take control of these protesters.
sentences.zh: 这些抗议者原本呼吁来接管政府的士兵，现在却抵达现场来接管这些抗议者。

sentences.en: And after several hours, they were able to retake control of the scene.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，他们重新控制了现场。

sentences.en: So Jack, what did you do once this attack was over?
sentences.zh: 那么杰克，这场袭击结束后你做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, the next morning, I head back to the encampment at the Army headquarters because I knew that many of the people there had to have been part of this riot on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我返回了陆军总部的大营地，因为我知道那里有很多人肯定参与了周日的这场骚乱。

sentences.en: I'm at the Army headquarters where I was just a week ago.
sentences.zh: 我正身处一周前去过的陆军总部。

sentences.en: Last week, it was no real problem.
sentences.zh: 上周这里还没什么问题。

sentences.en: But today, it is covered in soldiers, basically.
sentences.zh: 但今天，这里几乎到处都是士兵。

sentences.en: So a little frustrating for me not to be able to get close, but we're going to try to find another way in.
sentences.zh: 所以无法靠近让我觉得有点沮丧，但我们会尝试寻找另一条路进去。

sentences.en: And early on Monday morning,
sentences.zh: 在周一清晨，

sentences.en: the authorities swept through the encampment and actually detained 1,200 of the people that were staying there and ferried them away in buses for further questioning.
sentences.zh: 当局突袭了营地，扣留了1200名留在那里的滞留人员，并用大巴将他们运走以便进一步审问。

sentences.en: Now, at the beginning, it was really difficult to get close.
sentences.zh: 起初，想要靠近真的很困难。

sentences.en: There was army soldiers everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是陆军士兵。

sentences.en: They were turning me away.
sentences.zh: 他们把我拒之门外。

sentences.en: But eventually, I was able to figure out a way to get inside.
sentences.zh: 但最终，我想办法进到了里面。

sentences.en: And there were still some stragglers, still some protesters who were filing out with belongings.
sentences.zh: 仍然有一些落后者，还有一些抗议者正带着随身物品排队离开。

sentences.en: Then, to my surprise, I spotted Magno.
sentences.zh: 然后，令我惊讶的是，我发现了马格诺。

sentences.en: And it was this confused situation.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况很混乱。

sentences.en: It was unclear why he had not been detained.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚他为什么没有被拘留。

sentences.en: He was carrying some scattered belongings.
sentences.zh: 他拎着一些零星的物品。

sentences.en: His wife was not with him.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子不在身边。

sentences.en: He was with this other friend.
sentences.zh: 他和另一个朋友在一起。

sentences.en: And we got to talking, and Magno told me that, yes, he had been there.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了起来，马格诺告诉我，是的，他当时在场。

sentences.en: And he had participated in the invasion of some of these buildings.
sentences.zh: 并且他参与了对其中一些建筑的入侵。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And he openly admitted that he went into Congress.
sentences.zh: 他公开承认自己进入了国会。

sentences.en: And what did he say he did once he was inside?
sentences.zh: 那他说他在里面做了什么？

sentences.en: He basically said that he was only there to get other people out, that he was there to stop the destruction.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说他去那儿只是为了把其他人带出来，他是去制止破坏行为的。

sentences.en: And then he went on to tell me that he was certain that any of the real violence and destruction was actually carried out by people on the left who were disguised as Bolsonaro supporters.
sentences.zh: 接着他继续告诉我，他确信任何真正的暴力和破坏实际上都是由伪装成博索纳罗支持者的左翼人士实施的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And this was a claim that was repeated by many other protesters who I spoke to on Monday morning at this encampment.
sentences.zh: 周一早上在这个营地里，我采访的许多其他抗议者也重复了这种说法。

sentences.en: None of them with any evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们都没有任何证据。

sentences.en: And, in fact, all of them admitting they were just going off their gut.
sentences.zh: 事实上，所有人都承认他们只是凭直觉在胡说。

sentences.en: And at this point, there's really no evidence that that is the case.
sentences.zh: 而就目前而言，确实没有任何证据表明事实如此。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Tudo bem?
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙语：一切都好吗？

sentences.en: O carro ainda pode...
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙语：车子还可以……

sentences.en: So, now, as many of his other campmates have been detained, he is taking advantage of this confused moment in which there are army soldiers all over the place,
sentences.zh: 所以现在，由于他的许多同营伙伴都被拘留了，他正利用这个混乱的时刻——到处都是陆军士兵，

sentences.en: but no one really seems to be paying attention or caring, and he just starts heading across this big field towards the parking lot where his car has been parked.
sentences.zh: 但似乎没有人真正注意或关心——开始穿过这片大场院，走向他停车的停车场。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And eventually his wife is with him, and at his car, he starts to pack it up and get in.
sentences.zh: 最终他的妻子和他在一起，到了车旁，他开始收拾东西并上车。

sentences.en: I mean, basically, he is escaping police.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基本上他是在逃避警察。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a guy who admitted to just invading Congress the day before, now getting out of there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这家伙昨天才承认闯入了国会，现在正从那里脱身。

sentences.en: A gente pode acompanhar?
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙语：我们可以一起去吗？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: So, as he's about to leave, I ask him if I can get in.
sentences.zh: 所以，在他准备离开时，我问他我能不能上车。

sentences.en: And he waffles and then reluctantly agrees, and so...
sentences.zh: 他犹豫了一会儿，然后勉强同意了，所以……

sentences.en: Okay, brigado.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙语：好吧，谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm going to get in the car with him.
sentences.zh: 我要上他的车了。

sentences.en: Vamos.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙语：走吧。

sentences.en: My interpreter, Gustavo, and I jump in the back, and we head out with him.
sentences.zh: 我的翻译古斯塔沃和我跳进后座，和他一起出发了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And as we're driving out, he immediately starts talking about he's got a plan, a strategy to escape.
sentences.zh: 当我们开车离开时，他立刻开始谈论他有一个逃跑的计划和策略。

sentences.en: They're taking off their yellow shirts.
sentences.zh: 他们正在脱掉黄色的衬衫。

sentences.en: Pulls off his shirt, and he tells his friend in the back to take off his shirt as well,
sentences.zh: 他脱下自己的衬衫，并告诉后座的朋友也脱掉衬衫，

sentences.en: because they're both wearing these yellow national soccer jerseys that he worries will identify them as protesters.
sentences.zh: 因为他们都穿着黄色的国家足球队球衣，他担心这会暴露他们抗议者的身份。

sentences.en: And then we're driving along, and it seems like we're heading to his house.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开着车，看起来像是要回他家。

sentences.en: I'm going to get out of here, okay?
sentences.zh: 我要离开这里了，好吗？

sentences.en: Imagine.
sentences.zh: 想象一下。

sentences.en: I'm asking him more questions to try to understand what had happened and what his plans are, and...
sentences.zh: 我向他提出更多问题，试图了解发生了什么以及他的计划是什么，然后……

sentences.en: I overhear his wife tell him that your friends are nice, but they're asking too many questions.
sentences.zh: 我无意中听到他的妻子对他说，你的朋友人不错，但他们问的问题太多了。

sentences.en: And it seems to dawn on him that maybe as he makes his escape, it's not a great idea to have a reporter in the back seat.
sentences.zh: 他似乎突然意识到，在他逃跑的时候，后座坐着个记者可能不是个好主意。

sentences.en: Generally true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So, eventually, he pulls over at this bus station and kicks me out and tells me he'll call me and speeds off.
sentences.zh: 所以，最后他在这个公交车站停下车，把我赶了下去，告诉我会给我打电话，然后加速离开了。

sentences.en: So, as wild as that scene you just described is, Jack, this moment where Magno dumps you off at the side of the road and completes his escape,
sentences.zh: 杰克，你刚才描述的那个场景虽然很疯狂——马格诺把你扔在路边完成了他的逃跑，

sentences.en: it seems to hint at something very important, which is that this is now a giant crime scene, right?
sentences.zh: 但这似乎暗示了一件非常重要的事情，那就是这里现在是一个巨大的犯罪现场，对吧？

sentences.en: And that Brazil is about to experience what we just went through here in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 巴西即将经历我们在1月6日之后在美国刚刚经历过的事情，

sentences.en: after January 6th, which is a long and complicated quest for accountability and an effort to understand how an attack of this scale happened
sentences.zh: 那就是漫长而复杂的追责追求，以及努力弄清楚如此规模的袭击是如何发生的，

sentences.en: and who should be held responsible for it.
sentences.zh: 以及谁应为此负责。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So, Brazil is now starting what will likely be a long and drawn-out investigation and prosecution of the potentially upwards of thousands of people who partook in this invasion.
sentences.zh: 因此，巴西现在开始的可能是一场漫长而旷日持久的调查和起诉，对象可能是多达数千名参与此次入侵的人。

sentences.en: President Lula has been very forceful in the days following the riots, saying there will be prosecutions.
sentences.zh: 在骚乱发生后的几天里，卢拉总统态度非常强硬，称将会进行起诉。

sentences.en: The authorities have detained 1,500 people within 24 hours of the invasions and said that they will be held until the investigation is concluded.
sentences.zh: 当局在入侵发生后的24小时内拘留了1500人，并表示在调查结束前将一直关押他们。

sentences.en: And Congress seems poised to be opening a formal congressional investigation.
sentences.zh: 国会似乎也准备开启正式的国会调查。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's talks now about not just holding the people who invaded the buildings accountable, but also holding the people who helped fund the buses and the encampments
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，现在不仅在讨论追究那些闯入大楼的人的责任，还要追究资助大巴和营地的人的责任，

sentences.en: to also look at the people who maybe were pulling the strings or organizing or pushing many of these people
sentences.zh: 还要调查那些可能在幕后操纵、组织或推波助澜，促使许多人

sentences.en: in the direction of this attempt to what could be described as an attempted coup.
sentences.zh: 走向这场可以被描述为未遂政变的人。

sentences.en: And, of course, the person who looms over all of this is Jair Bolsonaro, just as Donald Trump did over January 6th in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当然，所有这一切背后挥之不去的人选就是雅伊尔·博索纳罗，就像唐纳德·特朗普在美国1月6日事件中所扮演的角色一样。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We know that the false belief that the election was stolen stems directly from the years of efforts by Bolsonaro to sow doubt in Brazilian election systeMs.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，选举被窃取的虚假信念直接源于博索纳罗多年来试图对巴西选举制度播下怀疑种子的努力。

sentences.en: Not only did he spread the lie that the election systems was right for the fraud, but he also instilled deep fear in his supporters that the left was bent on rigging the vote.
sentences.zh: 他不仅散布选举制度容易发生欺诈的谎言，还在支持者中根植了一种深深的恐惧，即左翼铁了心要操纵投票。

sentences.en: But I think the case of Bolsonaro is even more complicated than the case of Trump.
sentences.zh: 但我认为博索纳罗的情况比特朗普的情况还要复杂。

sentences.en: And that's because, well, we all know that in the aftermath of the 2020 election,
sentences.zh: 这是因为，众所周知，在2020年大选之后，

sentences.en: Donald Trump was adamant that the vote was stolen and he fought to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普坚信选举被窃取，并为推翻选举结果而战。

sentences.en: And on January 6th, as the vote was about to be certified, he stood down on the National Mall and directed his supporters to march to the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 在1月6日选票即将得到认证的时候，他站在国家广场上，指挥支持者向国会山游行。

sentences.en: Jair Bolsonaro did not do that.
sentences.zh: 雅伊尔·博索纳罗没有这么做。

sentences.en: When he lost the vote, he authorized a transition to power.
sentences.zh: 当他输掉选举时，他授权了权力的过渡。

sentences.en: He kind of went into hiding.
sentences.zh: 他某种程度上隐蔽了起来。

sentences.en: And then on the day of the invasion, he was thousands of miles away in Florida.
sentences.zh: 然后在入侵发生的那天，他在数千英里外的佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: And just days earlier, he had suggested to his supporters to move on.
sentences.zh: 就在几天前，他还曾暗示支持者向前看。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So his culpability is just different, you're saying.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，他的罪责是不一样的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, what happened in Brazil on Sunday is actually scarier than January 6th.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，周日在巴西发生的事情实际上比1月6日更可怕。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: Well, Bolsonaro had essentially told his supporters to move on and Bolsonaro himself had given up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，博索纳罗基本上已经告诉他的支持者向前看，博索纳罗本人也已经放弃了。

sentences.en: But it didn't matter.
sentences.zh: 但这并不重要。

sentences.en: His supporters were already moving forward without him.
sentences.zh: 他的支持者在没有他的情况下已经在前进了。

sentences.en: They had become so convinced in part from his own rhetoric and also in part from just the sea of misinformation online that they didn't need him anymore.
sentences.zh: 部分由于他自己的言论，也部分由于网络上铺天盖地的虚假信息，他们变得如此坚信不疑，以至于他们不再需要他了。

sentences.en: You know, the movement had become almost its own self-animating beast that was going to push forward towards the Capitol with or without him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个运动几乎变成了一个自我运转的庞然大物，无论有没有他，它都会向国会山推进。

sentences.en: And I think that was also in part because of what I found at the encampment with people like Magno.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是部分原因，因为我在营地里从像马格诺这样的人身上发现了这一点。

sentences.en: It's in some ways not only about politics.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这不仅关乎政治。

sentences.en: There's, I gather that there was a sense of identity that a lot of these people found in the movement.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，许多这些人在这场运动中找到了一种认同感。

sentences.en: They found purpose in it.
sentences.zh: 他们在其中找到了目标感。

sentences.en: And I think that's really powerful and strong.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的具有强大的力量。

sentences.en: And it means that when a politician tells you that, sorry, the fight is over, it's not so easy to just – for them to walk away.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，当一个政客对你说，抱歉，争端已经结束，他们要想一走了之并没有那么简单。

sentences.en: They were part of something larger than themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们是一项远大事业的一部分。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, this is an untested proposition in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这在美国是一个未经检验的命题。

sentences.en: because Donald Trump has never asked the millions of people who believe his election was stolen to move on.
sentences.zh: 因为唐纳德·特朗普从未要求数百万相信选举被窃取的人向前看。

sentences.en: But you're saying in Brazil, we've learned that there comes a point where even if the leader of a movement like this wants people to move on, wants it to come to an end,
sentences.zh: 但你说在巴西，我们了解到会有这样一个时刻：即使像这样一场运动的领导人希望人们向前看，希望这一切画上句号，

sentences.en: they can't make that happen.
sentences.zh: 他们也无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: And that is scary.
sentences.zh: 而这正是可怕的地方。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: In Brazil, this is really not that much about Bolsonaro anymore.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，这其实已经与博索纳罗没有太大关系了。

sentences.en: It's about a mass delusion.
sentences.zh: 这是一场群体性妄想。

sentences.en: It's about a large portion of the population believing that the country is heading for destruction and that they're the ones that must save it.
sentences.zh: 这是关于很大一部分人口坚信国家正在走向毁灭，而他们正是必须拯救国家的人。

sentences.en: Well, Jack, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，杰克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 以下是新一天你还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: California has issued evacuation orders for tens of thousands of residents as relentless rains raised fears of flooding and mudslides.
sentences.zh: 由于连绵大雨引发了人们对洪水和泥石流的担忧，加利福尼亚州已向数万居民下达了疏散令。

sentences.en: The rain has already killed at least 17 people and caused an estimated $1 billion in damage.
sentences.zh: 这场大雨已经造成至少17人死亡，并造成约10亿美元的经济损失。

sentences.en: And two Democratic congressmen from New York have asked the House Ethics Committee to investigate their Republican colleague,
sentences.zh: 来自纽约的两名民主党众议院议员已要求众议院道德委员会调查他们的共和党同僚、

sentences.en: Representative George Santos, who has admitted to lying to voters about much of his paSt.
sentences.zh: 众议员乔治·桑托斯，他曾承认在自己的大部分过去上对选民撒谎。

sentences.en: On Tuesday morning, the lawmakers, Daniel Goldman and Richie Torres, hand-delivered the request to Santos' office.
sentences.zh: 周二上午，议员丹尼尔·戈尔德曼和里奇·托雷斯亲自将请求送达了桑托斯的办公室。

sentences.en: Congressman, you're doing this in person?
sentences.zh: 议员，你们这是亲自送达吗？

sentences.en: We are.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What's the value of doing this in person?
sentences.zh: 亲自送达有什么价值？

sentences.en: The process requires us to deliver it in person.
sentences.zh: 程序要求我们必须亲自送达。

sentences.en: Goldman and Torres asked the committee to explore whether Santos broke the law when he filed financial disclosure forms that were late and omitted key details about his business.
sentences.zh: 戈尔德曼和托雷斯要求委员会调查桑托斯在提交迟交的财务披露表格时是否违法，这些表格遗漏了他业务的关键细节。

sentences.en: Why is it important to do?
sentences.zh: 为什么这样做很重要？

sentences.en: I think when you violate House Ethics, you should be held accountable.
sentences.zh: 我认为当你违反众议院道德规范时，你应该被追究责任。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Claire Tennesketter and Rob Zipko with help from Asta Chaturvedi.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由克莱尔·特内斯凯特和罗布·齐普科制作，阿斯塔·查图维迪提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow, fact-checked by Susan Lee, contains original music by Rowan Nemisto and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由丽莎·乔伊剪辑，苏珊·李核实事实，原创音乐由罗万·内米斯托和马里昂·洛萨诺创作，克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lanthverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由奇迹乐队的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰特弗克创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Gustavo Freitas and Yvonne Farah.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢古斯塔夫·弗雷塔斯和伊冯娜·法拉.

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱有时甚至令人惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
